<entry id="D00911">
<head-word>דִּמְעָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced. wds.) 
<italic>tear</italic>, collect.</definition>
<notes>
<italic>tears, weeping</italic>. Lam. R. to II, 11 דִּמְעַת הסם וכ' (Ar. החסית, Var. השום, v. Ar. Compl. ed. Koh. s. v. חסית) tears caused by pungent matter, mustard &c. Ib. ד' הקרר Ar. l. c. (ed. Amst. הקבר, ed. Lam. R. בית הכסא, v. Sabb. 152
<sup>a</sup> top); Ab. d’R. N. II, ch. XLVIII (ed. Schechter, p. 132 הדקר) tears caused by severe cold; a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. דְּמָעֹות</plural-form>. Ib.; Sabb. 151
<sup>b</sup>; Ab. d’R. N. ch. XLI (XLVIII, v. supra); a. fr.—B. Bath. 15
<sup>a</sup>, v. דֶּמַע.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>a</sup>; Ab. Zar. 28
<sup>b</sup> דִּמְעָתָא (or עֲתָא … sing.) constant tearing of the eyes.—Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup> דִּמְעֵי עיניה (some ed. דִּמְעָת, Ms. M. דְּמָעֵיה) tears dropped from his eyes.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00918">
<head-word>דֵּן, </head-word>
<head-word>דֵּין</head-word>
<head-word>דְּנָא, </head-word>
<head-word>דְּנָה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. (cmp. דָּא, דֵּךְ) 
<italic>this, that</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. VI, 3. Targ. Deut. II, 3 הָדֵן (ed. Berl. הָדֵין = הָא ד'); a. v. fr.—Lev. R. s. 7 מן הד' קריא from this verse (it is proven). Ib. s. 8 ד' אמר לינא בעיא לד' וכ' the one said, I do not want this (woman) &c. Sabb. 112
<sup>b</sup> לית ד' ב"א this is not (an ordinary) human being; ib. כגון ד' וכ' a man like this is worth the name of a human being; a. fr.—Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>d</sup> bot.; a. e. אסיר לך דנא this (piece) is forbidden to thee.—מן קדמת דנא ere this, formerly. Y. Sot. II, 17
<sup>d</sup>; a. e.—כְּדֵ' a) = h. פֹּה, 
<italic>here</italic> (cmp. כָּא, הָכָא). Targ. Jud. XVIII, 3. Targ. Is. XXII, 16 (some ed. בְּדֵין); b) 
<italic>like this, thus</italic>. Targ. Gen. XXXII, 4. Targ. Jud. XVIII, 4; a. fr. [Targ. Ps. II, 10 read; כְּדוּן.]—B. Bath. 75
<sup>a</sup> (play on כדכד, Is. LIV, 12) ליהוי כד' וכד' let it be as this one says, and as that one; Pesik. Aniy. p. 135
<sup>b</sup>; Pesik. R. s. 32.—בִּכְדֵין in this manner. Targ. I Kings XXII, 20.—מָדֵין = h. מַה־זֶּה, 
<italic>why</italic>. Targ. Jer. XXVI, 9; a. e.—אֵי מִדֵּין 
<italic>from what, which</italic>. Targ. Jon. I, 8.—דֵּינוּ (= דֵּין הוּ) 
<italic>this.</italic> Y. Erub. VII, 24
<sup>c</sup> top, a. e. חֵי ד' צד וכ' (= h. אֵיזֶהוּ) which is ‘side’, and which &c.?, v. הַיְידְּנוּ.—
<plural-form>Pl. דֵּינוּן, דֵּינֵי</plural-form>. Y. Snh. IV, 22
<sup>b</sup> bot. הי ד' וכ' which are the two additional ones?—[הָדֵין 
<italic>then</italic>, v. הֵידֵין.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00932">
<head-word>דָּנִסְטֵיס, </head-word>

<sense>
<definition> (δανειστής, danista) 
<italic>money-lender, usurer, creditor</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 29 טוס … (corr. acc.). Ib. s. 31, beg. דיוסטוס (corr. acc.). Num. R. s. 9, beg. הד' משבר שיניו the lender breaks the debtor’s teeth (enforces his claim). Y. Sabb. II, 5
<sup>b</sup> top (ref. to יַשִּׁי, Ps. LV, 16) he makes the angel of death ד' שלו (some ed. דינ') his creditor (to collect his debts, visit his sins). Y’lamd. Thazr. end (quot. in Ar.) דנסטס, (Var. דינסטיס, corr. acc.). [Ib. to Deut. IV, 30 אני דינאסטוס וכ' ed. Koh. (v. Var. ib.), v. דִּינָאטוֹס
<italic>.</italic>]—
<plural-form>Pl. דָּנִסְטִין</plural-form>. Ib. to Deut. XXIV, 10.—Y. B. Mets. II, 8
<sup>c</sup> אילין דאיסרטוס; Y. Ab. Zar. V, 42
<sup>b</sup> bot. אילין דאוסיניסי, read: דָּאנִסְטִיסֵי.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>d</italic>.—Sabb. 35

<entry id="D00950">
<head-word>דַּעַת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="D00943">דֵּעָה</xref>) 
<italic>knowledge, mind; temperament, physical disposition, constitution</italic>.</definition>
<notes> עלתה על ד' 
<italic>to occur to one’s mind, to strike</italic>. Sot. IX, 6 (45
<sup>b</sup>); a. fr.—שיקול הד' weighing of opinions, i.e. decision between opposite views. Snh. 6
<sup>a</sup> טעה בש' הד' made a mistake in deciding, against the common practice, a case concerning which there are opposite authorities, opp. to a decision against an established law; ib. 33
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Keth. IX, 33
<sup>a</sup>; Y. Snh. I, 18
<sup>a</sup> bot.—Y. Ḥag. II, 77
<sup>b</sup> top אין דַּעְתָּן נקיה their mind is not pure (unfit to study esoterics).—B. Mets. 11
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. ד' אחרת מקנה a deputized person (or fictitious person, e.g. one’s ground) can take possession. Snh. 25
<sup>a</sup> sq. תולה בד' עצמו one who makes the chance of a game dependent on his own action, e.g. throwing dice, תולה בד' יונו who makes it dependent on his dove’s flight.—Tosef. Ḥull. VII, 1 וד' מכרעת reason decides in favor &c.; Ḥull. 90
<sup>b</sup> מאי ד' ד' תורה by saying ‘reason decides’ does he mean a reasonable interpretation of the Biblical law, or is he in doubt and ‘reason decides’ means ד' נוטה his opinion inclines in favor of &c.?—מִדַּ', לַדַּ' 
<italic>with the consent of, with the knowledge of</italic>, opp. בעל כרח־, v. כּוֹרַח. Kidd. 44
<sup>a</sup> מד' אביה with her father’s consent; מִדַּעְתָּהּ with her consent. Ib. שלא לד' אביה without her father’s consent; a. fr.—ד' יפה good physical constitution, מי שדעתו י' 
<italic>not fastidious</italic> in taste, opp. אִיסְתְּנִיס q. v.—ד' קצרה 
<italic>impatience, greed</italic>, ד' רחבה 
<italic>contentedness</italic>. B. Bath. 145
<sup>b</sup> bot.; Snh. 101
<sup>a</sup> top.—Ber. 29
<sup>b</sup> דַּעְתָּם קצרה they are impatient (Rashi: they do not understand how to express their wishes).—Pes. 113
<sup>b</sup> אין הד' סובלתן whom the mind cannot endure; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. דֵּעוֹת,</plural-form> v. דֵּעָה.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="D00951">
<head-word>דַּעְתָּא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>Targ. Job XV, 2; a. fr.—Ber. 18
<sup>b</sup> אחלישתיה לדַעְתֵּיה thou madest him feel badly; Ḥull. 94
<sup>b</sup>.—Ber. 33
<sup>b</sup> bot. לא כיון דעתיה he had not his mind directed on it, recited without devotion. Ib. 36
<sup>a</sup> צנון אַדַּ' וכ' … people plant radishes with the intention of eating them when they are young. Ib. מאי דּעְתָּךְ כר"ע (in doing so) what was thy opinion? Is it that thou holdest to R. A.?—Kidd. 81
<sup>b</sup>; Ber. 26
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. לאו אַדַּעְתָּאִי I did not think of it. Keth. 3
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. כל דמקדש אַדַּ' וכ' whosoever betroths a wife to himself does so with the implicit understanding that his act is in agreement with the rabbinical enactments.—M. Kat. 17
<sup>a</sup>, v. 
<xref rid="B00128">בְּדַח</xref>. Gitt. 70
<sup>b</sup> ד' צילותא a clear mind, full consciousness; ד' שגישתא a confused mind, delirium. M. Kat. 26
<sup>b</sup> bot. כמה לית ביה ד' וכ' how little sense (manners) has this scholar!—סלקא דעתך (abbr. ס"ד) it enters thy mind, i.e. you may think. Ber. 41
<sup>b</sup> כל שיעוריה ס"ד ‘all its measures’,—you cannot mean that?—Pes. 2
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. קא ס"ד וכ' (abbr. קס"ד) thy first impression naturally was that he who said ‘light’ meant really &c. (an editorial remark for the sake of introducing a discussion on premises finally to be upset). Ib. 14
<sup>b</sup> דאי ס"ד וכ' for if we were to think that it was a rabbinical law; ib. 18
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Ib. top ואי ס"ד מכלים וכ' if we were to assume that he withdrew his opinion only as to vessels &c.; ib. 19
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—Sot. 46
<sup>a</sup> ס"ד אמינא … צריכא you may possibly think we say, i.e. you may be misled to interpret &c.; therefore (to obviate such a misinterpretation) a Biblical intimation is required; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<sup>b</sup>; 97
<sup>b</sup> (v. Rashi a. l.).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to examine minutely, search, investigate</italic> (charity cases); 
<italic>to trace genealogical records</italic> (corresp. to בָּדַק); in gen. 
<italic>to be very strict</italic> in religious observances; (with עם) 
<italic>to deal strictly with</italic> (esp. used of divine retribution).</definition>
<notes> Y. Peah VIII, 21
<sup>a</sup> מְדַקְדְּקִין בכסות וכ' you must make inquiries if one asks for clothes, but you must not &c., if food is asked for; Lev. R. s. 34 (B. Bath. 9
<sup>a</sup> בודקין).—Y. Kidd. IV, 65
<sup>d</sup> אין מד' אחריה you must not trace its past records. Y. B. Bath. IV, end, 14
<sup>d</sup> it is the custom in sales להיות מְדַקְדְּקִין to be strict, opp. בעין יפה liberal. Ex. R. s. 31 מד' עמהם he is stinting (illiberal) towards the poor. Y. Succ. I, 52
<sup>b</sup> top לא די' בה he paid no particular attention to its preparation. Ḥull. 4
<sup>a</sup> הרבה מד' בה יותר וכ' they are very strict in the observance, even more so than &c.; Tosef. Pes. I (II), 15.—Yeb. 121
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ps. L, 3) הקב"ה מד' עם וכ' the Lord deals with those around Him (the good) strictly, to a hair’s breadth; Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup>. Lev. R. s. 27; a. fr.—Tanḥ. Mishp. 11 למה אתה תְדַקְדֵּק בהכאתה why art thou so severe in punishing her?</notes></sense></senses>
